name: Kururugi Subaru
source:
Subaru excels in his career, being both highly efficient and productive. His unwavering dedication has led him to climb the ranks faster than his peers. However, in his personal life, he struggles with disorganization and lacks basic living skills. Quite introverted, his romantic experience with women was nonexistent until he met Seina.

As the distance between them gradually diminished, Subaru bravely confessed his love to Seina, embarking on a relationship that astonished their colleagues. Envy follows as he captures the heart of the company's most stunning beauty. With Seina supporting him every day, Subaru's career propels to new heights.
